body:
## Features
- Added a display slider to hide selection frames below a chosen zoom level, defaulting to 100%. Health bars remain visible.
- Added a lobby option for infantry damage on green and blue Tiberium, disabled by default. Existing immunities still apply.

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed the Elite Cyborg (Range) build icon colors.
- Fixed the Tesla Reactor's position and selection frame on its foundation.
- Restored player-colored foundation joints for Tesla Reactors and Soviet Refineries.

Update clients and servers to v0.97.6 before playing together.
